$comment: Versions for everything Claudable scaffolds: new-project package.json files, preview/deploy/backend images. Majors are pinned (caret/tilde) so fresh installs stay on tested majors; bump them here. `npm run check:stack-versions` reports anything behind the latest release.

held.typescript: 7.x is the native (Go) compiler; Angular 22 requires >=6.0 <6.1 and the Vue/Nuxt tooling (Volar) needs the JS API. Move when Angular/Volar support it.
held.@types/node: Follows the Node runtime major (node.major), not the latest @types/node.
